# Native wire frames both sides must agree on, as "<name> <hex>" lines.
#
# The client frames are what server/protocol.py's serialize_message writes,
# and runtime/engine/Protocol.cpp must decode them; the events are what
# Protocol.cpp's serializeEvent writes, and server/protocol.py must decode
# them. dev/tests/engine/protocol_test.cpp and
# dev/tests/server/test_protocol_python.py build the messages;
# runtime/engine/Protocol.hpp describes every layout.
